questions.prompt: A 45-year-old patient is diagnosed with an intestinal nematode infection and is prescribed albendazole. Which of the following best describes the primary mechanism of action of this benzimidazole compound?
options: Activation of glutamate-gated chloride channels causing flaccid paralysis
Inhibition of heme detoxification into non-toxic hemozoin
Inhibition of microtubule polymerization by binding to beta-tubulin
Interference with oxidative phosphorylation in adult tapeworms
Reductive bioactivation by ferredoxin leading to DNA fragmentation
